objectives_web_service.public_endpoints: Documented and publicly available for Medical Expert role only
objectives_web_service.note: Public JSON/XML web-service endpoint confirmed working (HTTP 200) for medical-expert role: https://mcc.ca/wp-json/mcc/medical-expert/en/?type=json&content=true. No credentials required.

objectives_web_service_scope_limitation.finding: The documented web service covers ONLY the Medical Expert role. No JSON/XML endpoint exists for the six non-Medical-Expert roles (Collaborator, Communicator, Health Advocate, Leader/Manager, Professional, Scholar).
objectives_web_service_scope_limitation.evidence: Official 2-page technical documentation PDF exclusively describes medical-expert URLs. Direct attempt at the analogous pattern for other roles (e.g. https://mcc.ca/wp-json/mcc/collaborator/en/?type=json&content=true) returned HTTP 404 rest_no_route.

mcq_guidelines.note: Formal MCC item-writing guidance is publicly documented, not purely internal

objectives_registry_complete.value: 192 Medical Expert objectives retrieved via official web service (content=true), covering all 192 titles cross-verified against the official medical-expert index page link list (192/192 exact match, zero unmatched). 6 non-Medical-Expert role pages captured in full as single role-level records (no per-objective IDs exist for these roles per MCC's own structure).
objectives_registry_complete.audit: reports/objectives_registry_audit.json - overall_registry_status: PASS; 16-item manual verification sample: 16/16 PASS

legacy_objective_ids.value: For Medical Expert objectives, the web-service 'id' field is confirmed identical to the official page-displayed 'Legacy ID' field (4/4 direct spot-checks; pattern holds across all 192 records with no counter-example found). No separate 'current ID' system exists on the official site.
legacy_objective_ids.non_expert_roles_note: The six non-Medical-Expert roles have no Legacy ID system at all - confirmed by direct inspection of all six official role pages.

surgery_weakness_dual_legacy_id_anomaly.question: Study Smarter's Surgery discipline list prints 'Weakness (not caused by cerebrovascular accident), 117 118' - two Legacy IDs for one title, unlike every other entry in the guide.
surgery_weakness_dual_legacy_id_anomaly.finding: Confirmed by direct visual inspection of the source PDF (page 10) that this is a genuine anomaly in the official document itself, not a text-extraction artifact. Legacy ID 117 correctly matches this title. Legacy ID 118 belongs to an unrelated Medical Expert group (Obesity/Weight loss/IUGR, none of which are titled 'Weakness' or appear elsewhere in the Surgery list).
surgery_weakness_dual_legacy_id_anomaly.required_source: Would require contacting MCC directly to confirm whether this is a guide typo or an intentional dual-reference
surgery_weakness_dual_legacy_id_anomaly.action_taken: Recorded verbatim in research/mcc/raw_retrieval/study_smarter_discipline_lists_raw.json with explicit anomaly annotation. Only Legacy ID 117 used in the reconciled mapping; 118 preserved as an unresolved side-note, not silently assigned to any objective.
surgery_weakness_dual_legacy_id_anomaly.impact: TRIVIAL - affects zero mapping decisions since ID 117 is unambiguous and correctly resolved; ID 118's spurious appearance here does not change Surgery's coverage of any objective

canmeds_role_percentages.question: What are the CanMEDS role percentage weights on the MCCQE?
canmeds_role_percentages.finding: MCC does not publish CanMEDS role percentages at all. The Blueprint (Physician Activities x Dimensions of Care) and the CanMEDS-based Examination Objectives are two deliberately separate classification systems. This is not a gap in current evidence retrieval - MCC's own materials confirm no such percentage breakdown exists to find.
canmeds_role_percentages.impact: NONE - do not infer or fabricate CanMEDS role percentages; continue treating blueprint.json and the CanMEDS role list as separate systems per existing guidance

data_integrity_notes: This document distinguishes between items that HAVE been confirmed from official sources (resolved) and items that genuinely remain unresolved. It does not list claims merely because the original Deep Research memo called them unresolved if they have since been verified. Phase 2 (2026-08-24) resolved the two former CRITICAL blockers (objectives_registry_complete, study_smarter_complete_mapping) plus blueprint_percentages_official_source and the objectives_web_service scope limitation. Zero remaining unresolved items block master_scope_crosswalk.json generation.
